en: Team Skull Grunt: This tunnel's Skull turf now! Toll's a battle. Pay up!
text: Tunelul ăsta e teritoriul Skull acum! Taxa e o luptă. Plătește!

en: Team Skull Grunt: Fine, fine. Toll waived. Skull's generous like that.
Team Skull Grunt: Yo! You lost? Lost to me is what you're gonna be!

We dug every one of these tunnels with our Diglett. Don't you go knocking any of them in, now.
text: Fiecare tunel de aici l-am săpat cu Diglett-ii noștri. Să nu cumva să dărâmi vreunul, să știi.
